snippet.title: STELLARCH Ranked Battle | Deterministic P2E TCG on Hive
snippet.description:
A ranked battle in STELLARCH, the deterministic trading card game on Hive.

Two players. Seven cards each, one commander and six Fighters. One seeded combat engine that plays the match out the same way every time. No luck on the night, just the team you drafted and the calls you made.

This is a live ranked match on the alpha ladder.

Play now (free): https://stellarch.io
Read the blog: https://peakd.com/@stellarch
Follow on X: https://x.com/Stellarch_tcg
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/K3geA9hD28

Currently in open alpha. Sign up and play.
